stories.headline: Trump calls GDP data released before midterms ‘fake’, demands investigation
stories.description: President says it was a deliberate decision to release ‘fake’ growth numbers before US midterm elections.

stories.headline: Guinea-Bissau presidential election delayed by two years
stories.description: Military leaders say presidential and legislative poll scheduled for December 6 will now take place in November 2028.

stories.headline: EU leaders struggle to agree on long-term budget, more money for Ukraine
stories.description: The bloc is holding an extraordinary summit in Brussels to discuss its budget proposal for 2028 to 2034.

stories.headline: How a teen’s death raises questions about Colombia’s security crackdown
stories.description: President Abelardo de la Espriella’s campaign against armed groups has resulted in accusations of extrajudicial killing.

stories.headline: Nearly 100 Labour MPs including ministerial aides oppose Rosebank oil field
stories.description: Energy Secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh will decide on drilling at the Shetland oil field within weeks.
